chapter: Coleman Hawkins, Bernie Young and doubling on tenor
title: Alto players who switched to tenor and Caldwell's doubling
summary: Discussion of Lester Young and others who began on alto; Caldwell doubled tenor and baritone with Arthur Gibbs's band and could pick up alto.
